generate_json_with_grammar_constraint: generate valid JSON output from a causal language model using an EBNF grammar constraint
create_incremental_grammar_constraint: create an IncrementalGrammarConstraint from an EBNF grammar file to constrain model generation
create_grammar_logits_processor: create a GrammarConstrainedLogitsProcessor to enforce grammar rules during text generation
run_grammar_constrained_generation: run grammar-constrained text generation with a Mistral model and JSON EBNF grammar
decode_batched_generations: decode batched model output tokens back to text strings using the tokenizer
